lines.text: PREVIOUSLY ON QUBLOX: A corporate virus bleached Neo-Amritsar of all saturated joy.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sayam bankrolled a turnstile, and Tushar froze a monkey riot in the gear cage.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ashwath hacked a Reply-All mothership, but the municipal render farm is melting!

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: And Sehaj's export has been sitting at 99% since yesterday morning. Move!
